answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 44619 Country: India Title: Missed salah Question: Is offering qaza salah somewhat better than not offering salah at all? Answer ID: 44619 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 508/486/N=1434) The qaza of missed salah is wajib and necessary. One shall be sinful if one does not do qaza or make a will before one’s death. All the four Imams and majority of Ulama have the same opinion in this issue. For details see Fatawa Usmani (1: 522-532) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
